name: RBX15 Classic Shirt and Pants Maker
tagline: Design Roblox templates without fighting your tools.
description: Windows desktop editor (Electron) for Roblox Classic R15 shirt and pants templates. Layer-based compositing, pattern and gradient region fills that wrap across connected panels, non-destructive image adjustments, word art, drawing tools, built for the exact 585x559 template grid.

screenshots.caption: Fills that wrap: one gradient across every torso panel, patterns tiling across the seams
Stack layers and adjust them without touching the original
Change a fill's angle after painting and every connected panel updates
Word art placed on the template
Pants: a pattern running down both legs

features: Pattern and gradient region fills (solid, linear, radial, stripes, checker, dots, camo) that wrap across connected panels and live-edit after painting
Non-destructive image adjustments (brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, RGB channels)
Word art generator — 15 fonts, six styles
Clothing detail generators (collars, cuffs, hems, seams, pockets)
Built-in asset packs: 156 drips + 25 word art PNGs
Placement presets (Fit Front, F+B, Stretch, Allover, Scatter)
Eraser tool, and undo/redo of the full editor state
No accounts, no telemetry; the only network request is Google Fonts for word art
